headline: US Enforces Naval Blockade with Hellfire Missiles, IRGC Threatens Global Infrastructure
subheadline: US Navy fired Hellfire missiles at M/V Vela Nova after crew ignored blockade warnings in Gulf of Oman; IRGC vowed to target global energy grids, power plants, and internet systems if Iran faces further threats.
lede: US forces kinetically enforced a naval blockade of Iranian ports by firing Hellfire missiles at a Panama-flagged container ship in the Gulf of Oman. The IRGC responded with explicit threats to target global energy infrastructure, power plants, and internet-connected systems worldwide. Concurrently, Houthi forces struck a Saudi military supply vessel in Bab al-Mandab, while 15+ Saudi tankers diverted toward the Strait of Hormuz amid unconfirmed reports of Iranian fire near Sirik. These actions signal a coordinated maritime escalation with high risks of miscalculation.

sections.title: Ukrainian Drone Strikes Target Russian Energy Infrastructure
sections.body: Ukrainian drones struck a Wildberries logistics complex in Voronezh region, a Rosneft refinery in Komsomolsk-on-Amur, and an Oskolnefteorgsintez plant in Oryol region. Russian forces retaliated with ballistic missile attacks on Kyiv, damaging a children's hospital and logistics facilities. Ground operations intensified near Pischane, with Ukrainian counterattacks destroying Russian groups in Shcherbakovka and Kudiivka. Russian 'Sever' grouping advanced near Kazachya Lopan on the Kharkiv front.

sections.title: Iranian Blockade Escalates with Global Threats
sections.body: US Navy fired Hellfire missiles at M/V Vela Nova after its crew ignored warnings while attempting to breach Iranian port blockades. The IRGC issued threats to target energy grids, power plants, and global internet systems if Iran faces further aggression. Houthi forces attacked a Saudi military supply vessel in Bab al-Mandab, while 15+ Saudi tankers moved toward the Strait of Hormuz amid reports of Iranian fire near Sirik. These developments suggest a multi-front maritime crisis.

sections.title: Coordinated Maritime Pressure Campaign
sections.body: The US blockade enforcement and IRGC's global infrastructure threats mark a significant escalation in maritime interdiction. Concurrent Houthi and Iranian actions create dual chokepoint risks in Bab al-Mandab and Hormuz. The reported Iranian fire near Sirik, if confirmed, would indicate direct military engagement at a critical strait, heightening the potential for unintended escalation.
